proof_body:
by
  intro a b c x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂
  have key : ∀ t : ℝ, a * ((1 - t) * x₁ + t * x₂) + b * ((1 - t) * y₁ + t * y₂) + c = (1 - t) * (a * x₁ + b * y₁ + c) + t * (a * x₂ + b * y₂ + c) := by
    intro t; ring
  simp only [key]
  generalize a * x₁ + b * y₁ + c = u
  generalize a * x₂ + b * y₂ + c = v
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, h0, h1, h⟩
    rcases h0.eq_or_lt with rfl | ht
    · have hu : u = 0 := by linarith
      simp [hu]
    · have hv : v * t = -((1 - t) * u) := by linarith
      have hz : t * (u * v) ≤ 0 := by
        have : t * (u * v) = -((1 - t) * u ^ 2) := by linear_combination u * hv
        rw [this]
        have : 0 ≤ (1 - t) * u ^ 2 := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg u)
        linarith
      by_contra hc
      push Not at hc
      have := mul_pos ht hc
      linarith
  · intro h
    by_cases hd : u - v = 0
    · have huv : u = v := by linarith
      subst huv
      have hu : u = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp (le_antisymm (by linarith) (sq_nonneg u))
      exact ⟨0, le_refl _, zero_le_one, by simp [hu]⟩
    · have hpos : 0 < (u - v) ^ 2 := by positivity
      refine ⟨u * (u - v) / (u - v) ^ 2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · apply div_nonneg _ hpos.le
        linarith [sq_nonneg u]
      · rw [div_le_one hpos]
        linarith [sq_nonneg v]
      · field_simp; ring
target_source: ∀ (a b c x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : ℝ), (∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 1 ∧ a * ((1 - t) * x₁ + t * x₂) + b * ((1 - t) * y₁ + t * y₂) + c = 0) ↔ (a * x₁ + b * y₁ + c) * (a * x₂ + b * y₂ + c) ≤ 0
